name: A 3348-Concept Row Enlargement with No Relative First Move
definition: From the certified nested maximum-class pair $O\subset P\subset Q_6$ of orders $22$ and $42$, form the $1364$-concept rectangular obstruction $H=(P\times O)\cup(O\times P)$. Replace a coordinate $z$ in the first block. With $P'=\pi_zP$ and $O'=\pi_zO$, take contraction $C=(P'\times O)\cup(O'\times P)$ and enlarged row $D=P'\times P$, then form $V(H,D)$.
properties: The row $D$ is dismantlable ample, but every corner of $D$ lies in $C$, so no relative peeling $D\searrow C$ can start. The output is nevertheless an ample pc-minimal obstruction by the one-row theorem. It is cornerless, and cannot arise from the ordinary block replacement by any nonempty sequence of ample one-concept additions, because the last added word would be a corner.
